data.title: Strategy (MSTR) Q3 Earnings Ride Bitcoin Windfall As Funding Risks Linger
data.description: Strategy entered this Q3 2026 release with a bruised share chart over the past month, yet the stock jumped 3.7% today to US$135.63. That reaction sits against a quarter defined by one thing above all else: a huge profit swing powered by Bitcoin fair value gains that pushed net income to about US$19.1b and basic earnings per share to roughly US$47.78. For a business long treated as a leveraged Bitcoin vehicle, the expectation was volatility. What investors actually got was a headline earnings...
